approvedCandidates.title: God's Covenant with Abraham — Abram Becomes Abraham
approvedCandidates.rationale: Verified absent 2026-08-01: 0 meta hits for Genesis 17 across scriptureAnchor, bibleStoryKey, title, bibleSourceRef and scriptureAnchorId in either lane, and absent from scripture_anchor_registry.json, anchor_coverage.json and kid_anchor_registry.json. Two reasons to gate it. (1) Coverage: the covenant chapter — the everlasting covenant, the sign of circumcision, the promise of Isaac by Sarah — sits between the corpus's Genesis 16 stories (1269, 1405) and its Genesis 18 material (1487, and the Genesis 18 pair), so the Abraham spine currently jumps the covenant that names both Abraham and Sarah. Its only prior provenance was docs/editorial/FULL_CANON_GAP_AUDIT_REFERENCE.md, which is reference only and authorizes nothing; Adam approved it into this gate on 2026-08-01.
approvedCandidates.cautions: HEAVY. Circumcision is a hard anchor — narrate it as the passage states it and no further; no invented interiority, no anatomical elaboration, no commentary. Adult lane only: the kid-subtraction problem this anchor poses is NOT solved here and no kid version is gated by this entry. Must preserve chronological placement — after the Genesis 16 stories (1269, 1405), before the Genesis 18 material (1487) — because the story is the Abram->Abraham and Sarai->Sarah rename seam itself.
